title: Return of the Flesh
description: A minecraft mod that allows the player to more safely eat Rotten Flesh
body:
# Return of the Flesh...

Is a mod about one thing

Eating Zombies!



But of course, we can't just EAT the rotten flesh raw, we need to purify it!

You still can cook it though, giving less hunger, but still allowing the urge to overtake you to eat more



To purify "Cooked Rotten Flesh", you must venture to the Nether to gain Blaze Powder to make purified water out of the least useful potion, the MUNDANE POTION!



Now, go have fun, and eat those zombies!
